title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky — Episode5 Ordeal

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Event Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's turn involves Rio conversing with the phoenix...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They'd been running around until then, but slowly begin to understand each other's feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “So, how does it feel...?”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “How does what feel...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“You know, living forever?
Don't you ever get lonely? You have to watch all your friends and family pass on, right?”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I think nothing of it.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I have long since gotten used to all that...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“So...
You do feel lonely...”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Ugh. Your mouth does not know when to stop, does it? If you have time to talk, you have time to catch me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hey, wait...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're on totally different levels in terms of acting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, Tsukasa's doing a really good job of showing Rio's timid and gentle nature.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “What is going on...?”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“As we converse...
My heart is being squeezed tighter and tighter for some reason.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“He is but a mere human.
They perish after only living a handful of years.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“And yet... Why?
Why...? Why?”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “I have never felt this before...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't take my eyes off her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Seiryuin's phoenix is just too captivating...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Can I do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Can I put on that kind of performance someday...?)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Stop there. Let's have our next candidate step in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I felt powerless in her presence...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(In the face of her phoenix...
My Rio seemed completely lifeless...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As I suspected, finding someone to play opposite Sakurako is not going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Okay, that concludes today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me... I'll see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seiryuin!!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
What is it?
I still have to practice on my own, you know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know you're very busy and I do apologize, but could you spare a minute of your time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Only a minute.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll get straight to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How in the world were you able to portray your character like that?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: There's no way I can answer that quickly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please! I have to know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Your phoenix felt so real...
It felt like she was right here. Just watching you, I was able to clearly see the forest and hear the wind in my ears.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The star I look up to... He also put on that kind of performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, please!
I beg you! Even just a small hint!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Fine...
If you're willing to go that far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Yes, really.
However, it's not like I did anything that out of the ordinary.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I simply wish to build the perfect character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Build the perfect character...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: For example...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Before trying to portray a character, I read books on related subjects... For the phoenix, I read this one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It says... “The True Identities of Fantastical Beasts”...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's a book about history and folklore that discusses how people came up with phoenixes.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I also researched my role by watching videos of birds and how they move so that I can learn to be like them.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Only after all that did I think about her feelings. The loneliness of never dying and endlessly being reborn from your own ashes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's only been one day since we were given our scripts. You've already done all that...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Presenting myself, a human, as a bird is no small feat. Especially one that does not actually exist...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: In order to convince others that my phoenix does actually exist, I need to form a crystal clear image in my head of what I'm trying to portray.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which is why I plan on reading at least fifty books before we open. I'll watch videos every day as well. I even asked one of my troupe mates to let me observe their pet bird at their home.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm going to do absolutely everything I can in order to properly portray a real phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's doing all this research for this role...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No wonder she's head and shoulders above the rest of us...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Seiryuin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll put what you said into practice right away by forming a clear image of how I want to portray Rio.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I commend your desire to follow in the footsteps of a superior person...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, Tenma, I doubt my method will actually work for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This is just my feeling, but you and I don't seem like the same type of actor...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same type...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Actors come in all shapes and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For instance, some prefer to gradually get into character while others may try to imitate their foibles... Of course, there are prodigies who can immediately take full control of their characters, but let's set that aside for now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Tsukasa, I'd say you're someone who likes to gradually get into character. Seemingly the most popular archetype.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gradually get into character...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In simpler terms, I believe you prefer to learn by doing since you and logical analyses of characters don't usually mix well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Right...
Rui's mentioned that before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Based on what she said just now, Seiryuin is the type of person who prefers to take a more analytical approach to her characters.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As for me...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: When you played Miles during the night show, I didn't get the sense that you broke him down into his fundamental components.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: So, I believe there is a better approach for you to take. What do you usually do when learning to play a new character...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ever since we did a rendition of “A Pianist Named Thorpe”, I've tried thinking about what my character and I have in common.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You like to get into character by first establishing an emotional link with who you'll be portraying.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
In that case...
They might be your best teacher...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They...?)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I have a friend who's the same type as you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: They too like to establish an emotional connection with their characters and try many different things to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Such as placing yourself in their environment or doing what you think they would do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Placing myself in their environment...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have some experience with that.
I remember attempting to understand how an impoverished shoeshine would feel by sitting along the side of the road.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Then, you have a basic understanding of what to do. However...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This person would actually become one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Become one?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Yes, in other words...
They'd shine shoes until they're able to make a living of it.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Of course, I don't mean that you should go around copying all of the roles that you play...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But your characters should gain more presence as you do what is necessary to bring them to life and be on the same page as them emotionally.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree with you there...
I can understand that method.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, will it be possible for me to do all this in less than a week...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: What you do until the audition is entirely up to you. But...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Tenma...
You've been going around claiming to be a future star, yes?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
So...
Why don't you become the star of this show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I promise to make this the best show ever by surpassing even you...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Hehe... That's more like it.
Well, I'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I made a fairly ostentatious claim there towards the end, but I'm very short on time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Will I really be able to figure out this character in less than a week? To get on the same level as Seiryuin...?)
Tsukasa!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, why'd you run off like that? What happened...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Apologies...
I had Seiryuin give me a few tips regarding how to get into character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?
That's a pretty big ask. And she agreed to help you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Well, to be clear, not using her way, but her friend's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I'm worried that I won't be able to figure out my character in time if I go with that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa...!
Is there anything we can do to help?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know we don't have much time, but we might be able to do something about that if we all work together...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, getting on the same level as Seiryuin as she is now will be incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you still wish to go through with this regardless...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa really amazes me sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even after seeing such an incredible performance, he's not giving up. I was convinced that it'd be impossible to catch up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanna help too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I have to learn more...
I have to absorb what I can from Tsukasa and Seiryuin's performance...! So that I can also get better!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
All of you...
Thank you! I really appreciate it!
